item.title: TP‑Link’s $1B US Router Plan Stalls Over Trump’s Ban
item.description: TP‑Link’s first Wi‑Fi 8 routers are blocked by Trump’s foreign router ban, spurring a near‑$1 billion U.S. manufacturing pledge and industry debate.

item.title: How to Diagnose a Slow Ethernet Cable in 7 Steps
item.description: Learn to pinpoint if a sluggish Ethernet link stems from a bad cable, mismatched hardware, or settings, using Windows, macOS and iPerf3 checks.

item.title: Balancing Ethernet and Wi‑Fi: The Ideal Home Network
item.description: Explore why mixing Ethernet cables with modern Wi‑Fi (Wi‑Fi 5‑7) delivers speed and reliability, and learn to design a future‑proof home network.

item.title: SpaceX Aims to Be America’s Fourth Mobile Carrier
item.description: SpaceX plans to launch a nationwide mobile network using 800 MHz low‑band spectrum and Starlink satellites, challenging AT&T, Verizon and T‑Mobile.

item.title: Wi‑Fi 7 Routers 2026: Best Picks & Industry Impact
item.description: Explore the top Wi‑Fi 7 routers of 2026, from budget to mesh, and how regulatory bans, security, and tech trends shape home networking today.

item.title: Comcast Turns Xfinity Routers Into Free Home Motion Sensors
item.description: Comcast’s Xfinity Shield adds Wi‑Fi Motion to XB7‑plus gateways, letting millions of routers act as free home motion detectors via the Xfinity app, with instant alerts.

item.title: Speed Up Slow Downloads: Proven Router Tweaks & Fixes
item.description: Learn how to diagnose slow Wi‑Fi, fix bufferbloat, optimize placement, switch bands, update firmware, and decide when a router upgrade is essential.
